verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs say AI works inside the Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks. Chargebee AI can also draft product families, plans, addons, prices and entitlements from a pricing page or description, which is a concrete delegated task. The MCP server evidence is about external clients and is not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the assistant's scope and supported task types, any limits or approval controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI inside the Chargebee Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks.
Let Chargebee AI draft product families, plans, addons, charges, prices, features, and entitlements from a pricing page, document, or description.
